methodology.basis: All source bytes and hashes read with git show at immutable baseline commit, not moving working tree.
methodology.scope: Every tracked shipping Swift compile input, plus test target membership. Counts are constructor/call sites, not dynamic element counts or runtime reachability.
methodology.lexicalCensus: Mask Swift comments and quoted/raw/multiline strings preserving offsets, match exact known control constructors; match local View/NSViewRepresentable composites separately; balance delimiters to record source modifier evidence.
methodology.limits: This is source enumeration, not Swift type checking. Branches, previews and unused compiled helpers remain included; constructor totals must not be described as visible buttons. Shared helper geometry and gesture semantics require call-site review and native AX proof.
methodology.privacy: Contains source declarations and control modifiers only; no real user transcripts, keys, audio or account data.
methodology.shapeClassification: Every primitive shape/cornerRadius site has a source-context category; direct constructor containment, control helper ownership, plus manual refinement of gesture hit regions, action labels, input/keycap helpers and domain/status art. Categories are source assessments, not rendered visual proof.
methodology.primitiveCountScope: 349 includes one DEBUG-only Button and compiled helper/preview sites. 258 local composite calls include screens and nested composition, never additional visible-control totals. 32 extra interaction sites, 7 legacy Alert.Button factory sites and 15 native host sites are separate.
methodology.compactSchema: sourceFiles resolves each numeric file id to path/hash/line count. targets.sources contains file ids. controlSites/chrome entries are [baseline line,operation,optional short source]; appearance and AX are [line,operation]. Omitted flags are false/absent, not proof of conformance. C/S/H ids resolve device-plan assignments. Local composite calls include screens and are separate from control counts. Full source is reconstructable at baseline commit. categoryKey/roleKey decode short K/R codes; compositeDefinitions=[component,file,line], compositeCalls=[file,line,component]. Shape geometry is available from exact baseline source at file:line; source bodies are intentionally omitted.
methodology.roleQualification: Each control role is a source requirement, not proof that a published Common role matches. System hosts retain native semantics. Source includes compiled unused helpers/previews; runtime reachability pending.
methodology.shapeCategories: control_chrome=actionable label/surface/input or gesture hit region; domain_data_or_status_art=data/status/progress/icon/instruction illustration; container_or_decoration=passive container/card/divider/panel; mixed_use_surface_helper=helper needs consumer role. Source assessments do not establish native appearance.
methodology.nativeHostCountQualification: 15 host declarations are separate from349primitive and32additional interaction sites; LockedTextView is a real NSTextView subclass input.
methodology.legacyAlertActions: Seven additional legacy SwiftUI Alert.Button factory sites (primary/secondary/dismiss .destructive/.cancel) are enumerated separately from349primitive and32gesture/NSAlert-button sites. Exact source labels retained through file:line; native system hosting remains.
